_meta.note: 一个任务一个文件。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Grand Youth#001.src: Oh, what am I to do...? How am I to be our next elder if I cannot even help him... Oh? Ehm, hello, stranger.
Grand Youth#001.dst: 噢，我该怎么办……？我连他都帮不了，要怎么当我们的下一任长老……噢？呃，你好，陌生人。
Grand Youth#001.speaker: Monte

Grand Youth#002.src: You most likely heard me. Our elder has fallen ill of some vile disease... I am to be our next elder, but I am not yet ready.
Grand Youth#002.dst: 你大概听到了。我们的长老染上了某种恶疾……我是下一任长老，但我还没准备好。
Grand Youth#002.speaker: Monte

Grand Youth#003.src: We have tried everything we can think of, but our healers and shamans have failed to cure him. We had some hope, however...
Grand Youth#003.dst: 我们能想到的办法都试过了，但我们的医者和萨满都治不好他。不过，我们原本还抱着一丝希望……
Grand Youth#003.speaker: Monte

Grand Youth#004.src: A man in your city, {p}, insists that he sells healing water that could cure him, but he is selling it for an exorbitant price that we cannot afford!
Grand Youth#004.dst: 你们城里，{p}，有个人一口咬定他卖的治愈之水能治好长老，可他开的价高得离谱，我们根本付不起！
Grand Youth#004.speaker: Monte

Grand Youth#005.src: I do not know where else to turn. I must ask you for help. If you can purchase it, I am sure that we could find a way to repay you.
Grand Youth#005.dst: 我不知道还能找谁了。我只能请你帮忙。如果你能把它买下来，我相信我们一定能想办法报答你。
Grand Youth#005.speaker: Monte

Grand Youth#006.src: I have written directions for you in your content book...please help our village.
Grand Youth#006.dst: 我已经在你的内容书里写下了路线……请帮帮我们的村子。
Grand Youth#006.speaker: Monte

Grand Youth#007.src: Visit the Salesman in {p} near the fountain.
Grand Youth#007.dst: 去 {p} 喷泉附近找推销员。

Grand Youth#008.src: Oh, why hello there! Come for my patented healing water, have you? Any problem instantly cured! Sniffles beware!
Grand Youth#008.dst: 噢，你好啊！是来买我的专利治愈之水的吧？什么毛病都能马上治好！流鼻涕的小心了！
Grand Youth#008.speaker: Salesman

Grand Youth#009.src: You're quite lucky, I only have a couple of bottles left, so it won't go cheap, but this is the good stuff! Only [{~} Liquified Emeralds]!
Grand Youth#009.dst: 你运气真好，我只剩几瓶了，所以不便宜，但这可是好东西！只要 [{~} 液态绿宝石]！
Grand Youth#009.speaker: Salesman

Grand Youth#010.src: What? Don't give me that look! This is the real stuff, very valuable and rare! What do ya take me for, some guy who'd sell lake water for a fortune?!
Grand Youth#010.dst: 什么？别那样看我！这可是真货，非常贵重又稀有！你把我当什么了，拿湖水卖天价的家伙吗？！
Grand Youth#010.speaker: Salesman

Grand Youth#011.src: Agh, agh! Put away the weapon! Put it away! Jeez, buddy! Alright, I admit it, I'm a fraudster! But, I do know where you get the real stuff, I ain't lying about that much.
Grand Youth#011.dst: 啊，啊！把武器收起来！收起来！天哪，老兄！好啦，我承认，我是骗子！不过我确实知道真货从哪里弄，这点我没说谎。
Grand Youth#011.speaker: Salesman

Grand Youth#012.src: There's this group of mages out in Dernel who know how to get the stuff. They're a bunch of tightwads and wouldn't get give me any real healing water to sell.
Grand Youth#012.dst: Dernel 那边有一群法师知道怎么弄到那东西。他们一个个都是铁公鸡，死活不肯给我真的治愈之水来卖。
Grand Youth#012.speaker: Salesman

Grand Youth#013.src: I doubt you'll have any better luck with it, but go on, try your luck.
Grand Youth#013.dst: 我看你也不会比我运气好，不过去吧，碰碰运气。
Grand Youth#013.speaker: Salesman

Grand Youth#014.src: Those tightwad mages are out in Dernel, on the lake with the big island. I doubt you'll convince them to give you any healing water, though.
Grand Youth#014.dst: 那些铁公鸡法师在 Dernel，就在有座大岛的湖上。不过我看你是说服不了他们给你治愈之水的。
Grand Youth#014.speaker: Salesman

Grand Youth#015.src: Talk to Isfurus in Dernel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Grand Youth#015.dst: 与 Dernel [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Isfurus 对话。

Grand Youth#016.src: Hm, hm...if it really does that, then...oh, is someone there? Erisk?
Grand Youth#016.dst: 嗯，嗯……如果它真的能那样，那……噢，有人在吗？Erisk？
Grand Youth#016.speaker: Isfurus

Grand Youth#017.src: Oh, a tourist. Heard about the healing water, I presume? Well, if you are here to make a quick buck, you can turn right back around from where you came.
Grand Youth#017.dst: 噢，是游客。我猜你是听说了治愈之水吧？好吧，如果你是来赚快钱的，可以原路回去了。
Grand Youth#017.speaker: Isfurus

Grand Youth#018.src: Hm...ah. Iboju's sister settlement...I see. I will trust this is an honest venture, then. The tribesmen are honourable.
Grand Youth#018.dst: 嗯……啊。Iboju 的姐妹聚落……我明白了。那我就相信这是件正当的事。那些部落民是讲道义的。
Grand Youth#018.speaker: Isfurus

Grand Youth#019.src: I will provide you a specially-prepared bottle to hold the water in. My colleague, Erisk, is within the fountain here. He can fill up the bottle for you.
Grand Youth#019.dst: 我会给你一个特制的瓶子来装水。我的同事 Erisk 就在这座喷泉里面，他可以帮你把瓶子装满。
Grand Youth#019.speaker: Isfurus

Grand Youth#020.src: There are a few animals in the fountain, however. They're wild and will most likely attack, but you look well-armoured. I doubt you'll have trouble.
Grand Youth#020.dst: 不过喷泉里有几只动物。它们很野，多半会攻击你，不过你的护甲看起来很好。我想你不会有麻烦的。
Grand Youth#020.speaker: Isfurus

Grand Youth#021.src: The entrance to the heart of the fountain is right below us. Take a deep breath and dive right in.
Grand Youth#021.dst: 通往喷泉核心的入口就在我们正下方。深吸一口气，直接潜下去。
Grand Youth#021.speaker: Isfurus

Grand Youth#022.src: Your directions are in your content book, friend. Always consult it if you are in a bind.
Grand Youth#022.dst: 路线在你的内容书里，朋友。遇到困难时随时查看。
Grand Youth#022.speaker: Isfurus

Grand Youth#023.src: Get the bottles filled by Erisk in the heart of the fountain to give Isfurus.
Grand Youth#023.dst: 在喷泉核心让 Erisk 把瓶子装满，交给 Isfurus。

Grand Youth#024.src: And who might you be? We certainly don't get many visitors down here.
Grand Youth#024.dst: 你是谁？我们这下面可很少有访客。
Grand Youth#024.speaker: Erisk

Grand Youth#025.src: Aha, Isfurus referred you. Yes, let me bottle this up for you, then. Once I do, make sure you don't drop them! Both the bottles and the water are valuable and difficult to replace.
Grand Youth#025.dst: 啊哈，是 Isfurus 介绍你来的。好，那我帮你把这个装瓶。装好之后可千万别摔了！瓶子和水都很贵重，很难再弄到。
Grand Youth#025.speaker: Erisk

Grand Youth#026.src: But what a marvel this place is...water to cure all ailments, even aging! I even hear there is a similar fountain someplace in Gavel, can you believe?
Grand Youth#026.dst: 不过这地方真是奇妙……能治百病的水，连衰老都能治！我甚至听说 Gavel 某处也有一座类似的喷泉，你敢相信吗？
Grand Youth#026.speaker: Erisk

Grand Youth#027.src: Oh, I nearly forgot. Just make sure to check back in with Isfurus before you leave! There is just one more step to the process he has to take care of.
Grand Youth#027.dst: 噢，我差点忘了。离开之前一定要回去找 Isfurus！还有最后一道程序得由他来处理。
Grand Youth#027.speaker: Erisk

Grand Youth#028.src: Just make sure to check back in with Isfurus before you leave!
Grand Youth#028.dst: 离开之前一定要回去找 Isfurus！
Grand Youth#028.speaker: Erisk

Grand Youth#029.dst: 替 Erisk 去跟 Isfurus 对话。

Grand Youth#030.src: Aha. You had no trouble, I assume? Hand the bottle here, I'll finish the seal and remove the impurities...
Grand Youth#030.dst: 啊哈。我猜你没遇到什么麻烦吧？把瓶子给我，我来封好瓶口，去除杂质……
Grand Youth#030.speaker: Isfurus

Grand Youth#031.src: ...done. There is much potential here...ancient tribal markings repeat the word "youth" over and again. It could be used, or abused...
Grand Youth#031.dst: ……好了。这里潜力无穷……古老的部落刻纹一遍又一遍地重复着“青春”这个词。它可以被善用，也可以被滥用……
Grand Youth#031.speaker: Isfurus

Grand Youth#032.src: Anyways, you have your water. Not to be rude, but I must ask that you leave me to my research now. You have your delivery to make anyway, correct?
Grand Youth#032.dst: 总之，你拿到水了。不是我无礼，但现在我得请你让我继续研究了。反正你还要去送货，对吧？
Grand Youth#032.speaker: Isfurus

Grand Youth#033.src: Your directions are in your content book, friend. Always consult it if you are in a bind.
Grand Youth#033.dst: 路线在你的内容书里，朋友。遇到困难时随时查看。
Grand Youth#033.speaker: Isfurus

Grand Youth#034.src: Bring back the bottle of healing water to Monte.
Grand Youth#034.dst: 把那瓶治愈之水带回给 Monte。

Grand Youth#035.src: You have returned, I see. Have you the healing water?
Grand Youth#035.dst: 看来你回来了。治愈之水拿到了吗？
Grand Youth#035.speaker: Monte

Grand Youth#036.src: Aha, perfect! If this not work, then...no, I must have faith.
Grand Youth#036.dst: 啊哈，太好了！要是这也不管用，那……不，我必须有信心。
Grand Youth#036.speaker: Monte

Grand Youth#037.src: From the bottom of my heart, thank you. I know we surely will not be able to compensate you for the price of the water...
Grand Youth#037.dst: 我打心底里感谢你。我知道我们肯定没办法补偿你买水的钱……
Grand Youth#037.speaker: Monte

Grand Youth#038.src: ...but here. This is the summation of our village's riches. For aiding us, consider it yours.
Grand Youth#038.dst: ……不过，给你。这是我们村子全部的财富。你帮了我们，这些就归你了。
Grand Youth#038.speaker: Monte
